name: Crumbling Ravener Husk
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-24: Breaking The Storm: Parting Clouds

generalAbilities.name: Soulsense 60 feet
generalAbilities.description: A ravener senses the spiritual essence of living and undead creatures within the listed range. Creatures whose material bodies are one unit with their souls, like celestials and fiends, appear brighter to this sense.

defensiveAbilities.name: Boneshatter
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The ravener husk takes bludgeoning damage

Effect The ravener's brittle bones shatter, spraying bone shards everywhere. Every creature within a 10ft Emanation of the ravener husk takes 5d6 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
90 feet. DC 25 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The ravener husk breathes a torrent of void energy that deals 11d6 Void Damage damage in a 40ft Cone (Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw save).

They can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.
